text: Gross margin was 34.0 percent in 2024, down from 35.2 percent in 2023, as higher freight and markdown activity offset pricing improvements. We also experienced a modest increase in inventory during the year, which contributed to operating costs and tighter liquidity. Net income was $52 million, reflecting careful expense management.
Current assets increased to $450 million while current liabilities were $310 million. Current ratio remained stable, and we continued to monitor debt and equity levels as we funded growth.

We delivered solid demand across our store base in 2023, and we maintained a disciplined approach to pricing and promotions. Gross margins were 33.8 percent, supported by favorable product mix and a steady cost base. Operating income improved as we focused on productivity and better inventory turns.

Revenue increased to $700 million and gross margin improved to 35.0 percent as supply chain conditions normalized and we expanded our private-label assortment. Operating income also rose, reflecting lower logistics costs and improved productivity. We believe the business remains well positioned for continued expansion.

Revenue increased to $890 million, and gross margin improved to 32.6 percent as channel mix strengthened. Operating income rose as we simplified the assortment and increased productivity. We continue to focus on balancing inventory investments with margin stability.
